connect.title: Qqen ɣer LinkedIn
connect.intro: Asekcem s umḍan LinkedIn i yettḍafaren isalan-ik. Leadrat yeqqar kan imiḍanen-ik n usmel, iqeddacen Lead Gen Form d ttawilat n usmel, yerna yettazen-d imuttiyen i t-tesbeddeḍ.
connect.need1: A dduṛ deg uḥric n usmel LinkedIn (Aseḍru neɣ nnig-s).
connect.need2: Tamlilt deg usebter n tkebbanit icudden (Adbel, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Aqeddac neɣ Anasli) - LinkedIn yettḥettim-it ad icerreg iqeddacen.
connect.need3: Asteqsi n uṭun n tilifun deg Lead Gen Forms -ik - leads war uṭun n tilifun ur yezmir ara ad yettwarnu.

connection.confirmDisconnect: Qqes assaɣ LinkedIn ? Sinkring yettwaḥbes yerna ttwakksen yiferdisen n unekcum. Ttwaḥerzen yiḍrisen, tistaḍin d uḍris n tigawt.
connection.noPermission: Tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ asebter-a. Acuddu d ubeddel n tesɣunin yessefk-as ttesriḥ n "Asnefli n tesɣunin".
connection.fetchTitle: Awi-d imeslayen s umḍan n wass
connection.fetchHint: Iḍrisen imaynuten ttwaḍefren yal kra n tedqiqin yerna 7 wussan ineggura ttwaɛerḍen yal ass, dɣa ulac d acu ay yettwaxṣaren. Seqdec aya i yiɛeggalen seg uqbel ad tcuddeḍ, neɣ akken ad twaliḍ tikkelt nniḍen tallit (armi d 90 n wussan deg yiwet n tikkelt). Leads yakan deg Leadrat ttwaqbalen.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Ini-d LinkedIn anwa seg yimḍebbren-is yuɣalen d iɛeggalen n tidet. Mi ara yaweḍ umdan LinkedIn ɣer yiwen n uswir ay tefrenḍ ddaw-a, Leadrat ad t-id-yesmekti i LinkedIn , s waya, isalan n tḥemla-nnek sseknen-d taɣara n umdan yerna LinkedIn yezmer ad yaf ugar n medden am yimdanen-nnek igerrzen. Ala ID n usmel LinkedIn d yiwen n usmel n yiwen n ubrid n tmacinin n tmacinin i yettwazen.
capi.created: Asnulfu yettwaxleq-d deg LinkedIn yerna yettwasbedd s tkarḍa.
